title: Fleet envelope (server channel, protocol v1)
description: Every WebSocket message on /api/fleet/ws is one UTF-8 JSON text frame (max 1 MiB) of this shape. The payload is validated separately, against messages/<type>.json. FLEET.md §5.

type.description: Message type. Single-word types (hello, welcome, ping, pong, ack, error) have no dot.

ts.description: sender clock, ms since Unix epoch

ref.description: id of the message this answers

epoch.description: assignment epoch, required on match-scoped messages
